Anna L: Quick Q — where's the canonical dashboard for TTFT/p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec for runtime? Need to point PMs to something.

Mike H: Use Grafana dash: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/rt-latency — panels: "TTFT p50/p95/p99", "tokens/sec by model", "reqs by path". Jaeger for traces: https://jaeger.redwood.company/trace/ (use trace ID from panel).

Sasha V: For quick lookup, open the "Latency > TTFT by model" panel, set time range to 6h and group by model + route. Filters: env=prod, region if you want region-split.

Anna L: thx. Any quick Loki queries for logs to check prefix/KV-cache misses? PM wants root-cause checklist.

Ravi K: Yep, Loki quick example:
```
{app=~"runtime.*", env="prod"} |= "kv-cache-miss" | json | unwrap token_count
```
This surfaces ops where KV misses correlate with high token generation.

Ravi K: PromQL for tokens/sec (use in Grafana query expr):
```
sum by(model) (rate(runtime_tokens_processed_total[1m]))
```
Use 1m for live dashboards, 5m for alerting to smooth noise.

Mike H: On noisy p95 alerts — common fixes: bump eval window to 5m, change aggregation to histogram_quantile on request histograms, and exclude warmup or synthetic routes. Also consider alerting on sustained deviation (e.g., p95 > threshold for 3/5 minutes) rather than single-eval spikes.

Sasha V: Example p95 alert expr:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route!~"warmup.*"}[5m])) by (le, model))
```
This skips warmup noise and uses 5m smoothing.

Anna L: Ping @Sasha — can you review the patch to update the alert playbook and link to the dashboard? PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/345

Sasha V: on it, will review after standup :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for main -> prod at 2026-03-17T10:12Z

Anna L: Also adding short doc for PMs: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/OBS/ttft-tokens-guide — includes a small runbook: where to look first (tokens/sec panel, TTFT p95, traces), quick Loki snippets, and who to page.

Mike H: If you see a p95 spike, check trace correlator + tokens/sec panel first. Cold starts + KV misses explain most transient spikes. If it's sustained, check model sharding and pod restarts.

Anna L: Thanks all — I'll collate these links and send a short handoff to PMs this afternoon.
